summary: Completed comprehensive testing of PWA romantic app with password gate, heart animation, and editor/user modes. All core features working correctly with localStorage persistence.
passed_tests: Password gate loads with dark theme and cobwebs
Invalid password shows error message correctly
User password (1234) triggers heart animation with correct caption
Editor password (Hxdi.132) skips heart animation and goes directly to main app
Heart animation transitions from dark broken heart to light filled heart
Heart caption 'You are the reason my heart beats this way' displays correctly
Editor sees 3 tabs in navigation (Reasons, You, blank white)
User sees only 2 tabs in navigation (Reasons, You)
Editor can add/edit/delete reasons successfully
Editor can add/edit/delete timeline items successfully
Tab 3 for editor shows blank white screen as expected
User sees swipeable cards in Reasons tab when content exists
User sees timeline view in You tab with proper content
localStorage persists data across sessions and refreshes
Password visibility toggle works correctly
Navigation between tabs works on desktop, tablet, and mobile
Progress indicators show correctly in swipe deck
Next/Previous buttons work in swipe deck
Data synchronization between editor and user views works correctly
PWA features: Web App Manifest detected, proper viewport configuration
Service Worker registration working (PWA functionality)
Mobile responsiveness works correctly across different screen sizes
Heart animation only shows once per user (hasSeenHeart state persisted)
Editor changes are immediately visible to users after login
